time-tracker.name: timer_start
time-tracker.description: Start tracking time on a project. Only one timer runs at a time: starting a new one stops and logs the previous one.

time-tracker.name: timer_stop
time-tracker.description: Stop the running timer and log it as a time entry. Returns the duration and the entry id.

time-tracker.name: timer_status
time-tracker.description: Show the running timer, how long it has been running, and today's total so far.

time-tracker.name: entry_add
time-tracker.description: Log time you already worked. Give start plus either end or minutes.

time-tracker.name: entry_list
time-tracker.description: List logged time entries as a compact table. Free tier shows the last 7 days.

time-tracker.name: entry_delete
time-tracker.description: Delete one time entry by id.

time-tracker.name: entry_edit
time-tracker.description: Change fields of an existing entry. Only the fields you pass are changed.

time-tracker.name: project_set_rate
time-tracker.description: Set the hourly rate used to turn tracked hours into money for a project.

time-tracker.name: report
time-tracker.description: Total tracked hours and money for a period, grouped by project, day, task or tag. Free tier covers the last 7 days.

time-tracker.name: export_csv
time-tracker.description: Write time entries to a CSV file you can hand to a bookkeeper or import into a spreadsheet. Free tier exports the last 7 days.

time-tracker.name: invoice_summary
time-tracker.description: Turn tracked time into invoice line items for one project: hours, rate, amount per task, plus the total.

price-tracker.name: price_check
price-tracker.description: Fetch a product page right now and report its price, currency and title, plus the change against the last price stored for that URL. Does not create a watch.

price-tracker.name: watch_add
price-tracker.description: Start tracking a product page. Fetches it once and stores the first observation. Optionally set a target price to be alerted about.

price-tracker.name: watch_list
price-tracker.description: Show every tracked item with its current price, target and last check time.

price-tracker.name: watch_remove
price-tracker.description: Stop tracking an item, by watch id or by URL. Its history is deleted.

price-tracker.name: watch_refresh
price-tracker.description: Re-fetch one watch or every watch, append the new observations and show current, previous, min, max, change % and target hits.

price-tracker.name: price_history
price-tracker.description: List the stored observations for one watch, newest last. Free shows the last 10.

price-tracker.name: price_add_manual
price-tracker.description: Store a price you read yourself, for shops that block automated requests. Creates the watch if it does not exist yet.

price-tracker.name: alerts_pending
price-tracker.description: Show watches whose latest price is at or below the target, or which dropped ${DROP_ALERT_PCT}% or more against the previous observation.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_info
spreadsheet.description: Open an xlsx or csv file and describe it: sheet names, size, guessed header row, per-column type, sample values and empty counts. Start here before reading or querying.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_read
spreadsheet.description: Read rows from a sheet as a text table, JSON records or CSV. Use limit/offset to page through big files, or range for an A1 block like B2:F40.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_query
spreadsheet.description: Filter, pick columns and sort rows without writing any code. where uses a small safe expression language: comparisons = != > >= < <= plus contains / startswith / endswith, combined with AND, OR, NOT and parentheses.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_stats
spreadsheet.description: Per-column count, empty count, distinct values, min, max, sum, mean and median. Numbers are parsed from currency and percent text too.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_find
spreadsheet.description: Search every cell for text (case insensitive) and return cell addresses with a preview of the row it is on.

spreadsheet.name: sheet_write
spreadsheet.description: Write rows to a spreadsheet. rows may be objects (keys become headers) or arrays (first array is the header row).

spreadsheet.name: sheet_add_column
spreadsheet.description: Convert a sheet to csv, xlsx or json. Writes a new file next to the source unless out_path is given.

invoice.name: client_add
invoice.description: Store a client so invoices can refer to them by name. Re-adding the same name updates the stored details.

invoice.name: client_list
invoice.description: List every stored client with their id, address, email and VAT id.

invoice.name: invoice_create

invoice.name: invoice_from_hours
invoice.description: Shortcut for the common case: bill one client for N hours at an hourly rate. Creates a single-line invoice.

invoice.name: invoice_list
invoice.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status (unpaid, paid, partial), client, and an issue-date range.

invoice.name: invoice_get
invoice.description: Return the full stored record for one invoice number, including every line and tax breakdown.

invoice.name: invoice_mark_paid
invoice.description: Record a payment. Without an amount the invoice is marked fully paid; a smaller amount marks it partial and reports the remaining balance.

invoice.name: invoice_pdf
invoice.description: Render an invoice as an A4 PDF you can send: issuer block, client block, dates, item table with wrapped descriptions, subtotal, discount, tax lines per rate, total, payment details and notes. Returns the file path.

invoice.name: overdue_report
invoice.description: List every unpaid or partly paid invoice past its due date with days overdue, plus outstanding totals per currency. Pro.

expense-tracker.name: expense_add

expense-tracker.name: expense_list
expense-tracker.description: List expenses in a date range, optionally filtered by project, category or billable flag. Totals are grouped by currency and never mixed.

expense-tracker.name: expense_update
expense-tracker.description: Change any field of a stored expense by id. Only the fields you pass are changed.

expense-tracker.name: expense_delete
expense-tracker.description: Delete one expense by id. The receipt file itself is left on disk.

expense-tracker.description: Attach a receipt file to a stored expense. The file must exist; its path and sha256 are stored so a later audit can prove the file has not changed.

expense-tracker.name: expense_summary
expense-tracker.description: Totals for a date range grouped by category, project, month or merchant. Every group is reported per currency with the gross, the net and the VAT; currencies are never added together.

expense-tracker.description: Record a business trip as an expense. Money is distance x rate. The built-in table (PL 1.15 PLN/km, UK 0.45 GBP/mile, US 0.70 USD/mile, EU 0.30 EUR/km) is one flat approximate rate per region: it has no effective dates,

expense-tracker.description: Write the expenses in a date range to a csv, xlsx or json file and return its path. Nothing partial is ever written: if a limit is hit the file is not created at all.

expense-tracker.name: expense_to_invoice

clauses.name: clause_delete

clauses.name: clause_search

kanban.name: task_list
kanban.description: List tasks as a table, filtered by project, column, tag, due date or overdue.

bank-statement.description: List the imported accounts with their bank, currency, transaction count and date range.

quotes.name: quote_create
quotes.description: Quote a client: line items with quantity and unit price in minor units, VAT per line or the business default, an optional discount and a validity window. Returns the quote id and the totals.

quotes.name: quote_list
quotes.description: Every quote with its client, total, validity and state (open, expired, accepted or declined). Filter by state, by client or by quote date range.

quotes.name: quote_get
quotes.description: The full stored record for one quote: every line with its unit price and VAT, the totals, the validity date, the notes and, when it was accepted, the invoice it became.

quotes.name: quote_update
quotes.description: Revise a quote that is still open: line items, currency, discount, VAT default, validity or notes. Totals are recomputed. An accepted or declined quote is never edited.

quotes.name: quote_send_text
quotes.description: Turn a quote into a plain-text summary with the line table, the VAT lines, the total and the validity date, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

quotes.name: quote_accept
quotes.description: Mark a quote accepted and turn it into an invoice: created directly in the invoice server when its store is present, otherwise returned as invoice_create-ready line items. The numbers are copied, never recomputed.

quotes.name: quote_decline
quotes.description: Mark a quote as lost, with an optional reason, so it stops counting against the open quotes and shows up in the win rate. An accepted quote is never turned back.

quotes.name: quote_pdf
quotes.description: Call this tool to write the A4 PDF of one quote and return the file path. Same layout as the invoice PDF, with the validity date and an acceptance block. Pro.

quotes.name: quote_report
quotes.description: Totals per currency for open, accepted, declined and expired quotes, with counts, the value still open and the win rate. Pro.

barcode.name: qr_create
barcode.description: Call this tool to turn text or a URL into a QR code, as an SVG returned inline or written to out_path, or as a PNG at a chosen pixel size (Pro).

barcode.name: qr_wifi
barcode.description: Call this tool to make a QR code that joins a WiFi network when scanned: network name, password and security type, written to out_path or returned as SVG.

barcode.name: qr_vcard
barcode.description: Call this tool to make a QR code that adds a contact when scanned (vCard 3.0: name, org, phone, email, URL, address), written to out_path or returned as SVG.

barcode.name: qr_payment_sepa
barcode.description: Call this tool to make an EPC069-12 payment QR code a euro banking app can scan: IBAN, beneficiary name, optional amount and reference. The IBAN is checked before drawing.

barcode.name: invoice_payment_qr
barcode.description: Call this tool to make the payment QR code for an invoice: your IBAN and name come from the shared business profile, the amount and reference from invoice_id or from the arguments.

barcode.name: barcode_create
barcode.description: Call this tool to draw a linear barcode (code128, ean13, ean8, upca) as SVG or PNG. A short EAN or UPC gets its check digit computed; a wrong one is refused, never redrawn.

barcode.name: barcode_batch
barcode.description: Call this tool to draw many barcodes or QR codes at once from a list of rows, each with its own value and file name, into out_dir. Pro; the free tier does one code per call.

barcode.name: code_list
barcode.description: List the codes this server generated, newest first, with what each one carried and where it was written, plus how many of this month's free allowance are left.

zip.name: zip_create
zip.description: Call this tool to pack files or a whole directory (with glob patterns) into a new .zip at out_path. Entry names are always relative, so the archive cannot write outside where it is unpacked.

zip.name: zip_list
zip.description: Call this tool to list an archive's entries with sizes, compressed sizes and ratios, and to flag what is dangerous in it: absolute paths, .., symlinks, encrypted entries, duplicate names and compression bombs.

zip.name: zip_extract
zip.description: Call this tool to unpack an archive into out_dir. Traversal, absolute-path and symlink entries are refused, a size and ratio cap stops a zip bomb, and dry_run reports exactly what would be written.

zip.name: zip_add
zip.description: Call this tool to add files to an existing archive. The archive is rebuilt from its entries and written tmp-then-rename, so a failure part way leaves the original file exactly as it was.

zip.name: zip_extract_text
zip.description: Call this tool to read one text entry out of an archive without unpacking anything: give the entry name and the text comes back inline. Binary entries are refused by name rather than printed as noise.

zip.name: zip_bundle_month
zip.description: Call this tool to zip one month of invoices, quotes and exports written by the sibling servers into their default output folders. Best effort: it names every folder it looked in and what it found.

zip.name: zip_history
zip.description: List the archives this server created, newest first, with their entry counts and sizes, plus how many of this month's free allowance are left.

billing-docs.name: credit_note_create
billing-docs.description: Issue a credit note against one invoice: the whole invoice, a gross amount, or named lines with quantities. Line totals are stored negative in minor units and the invoice's VAT rates are reused.

billing-docs.name: credit_note_list
billing-docs.description: Every credit note with its invoice, client, reason and negative total. Filter by invoice number, by client or by issue date range.

billing-docs.name: credit_note_get
billing-docs.description: The full stored record for one credit note: every negated line, the VAT lines, the totals, the reason and the invoice it was issued against.

billing-docs.name: credit_note_pdf
billing-docs.description: Call this tool to write the A4 PDF of one credit note and return the file path. The invoice layout, titled CREDIT NOTE and carrying the invoice number it reverses. Pro.

billing-docs.name: credit_note_text
billing-docs.description: Turn a credit note into a plain-text summary with the negated line table, the VAT lines, the total and the invoice it reverses, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

billing-docs.name: purchase_order_create
billing-docs.description: Order from a supplier: line items with quantity and unit price in minor units, VAT, a currency and an expected delivery date. You are the buyer, from the shared business profile.

billing-docs.name: purchase_order_list
billing-docs.description: Every purchase order with its supplier, total, expected delivery date and status (open, partially received or received). Filter by status, by supplier or by order date range.

billing-docs.name: purchase_order_get
billing-docs.description: The full stored record for one purchase order: the buyer and supplier blocks, every line with its unit price and VAT, the totals, the expected delivery date and what has been received.

billing-docs.name: purchase_order_pdf
billing-docs.description: Call this tool to write the A4 PDF of one purchase order and return the file path. The invoice layout, titled PURCHASE ORDER, with the buyer, the supplier and the delivery date. Pro.

billing-docs.name: purchase_order_text
billing-docs.description: Turn a purchase order into a plain-text summary with the line table, the VAT lines, the total and the delivery date, ready to paste into an email to the supplier. Free on every tier.

billing-docs.name: purchase_order_receive
billing-docs.description: Record that a purchase order arrived, in full or in part. A partial receipt keeps the order open and is kept on the record with its date and note; a full receipt closes it.

billing-docs.name: billing_docs_report
billing-docs.description: What has been credited back per currency, against how many invoices, and what is still on order per currency, with the purchase orders whose delivery date has passed. Pro.

deposits.name: deposit_record
deposits.description: Record a security or retainer deposit received from a client, in minor units, with its currency, the date it arrived and the bank reference. Returns the DEP-YYYY-NNNN id.

deposits.name: deposit_list
deposits.description: List deposits with what was received, applied, refunded and still held on each. Filter by client, by status held, applied or refunded, by kind and by received date range.

deposits.name: deposit_apply
deposits.description: Apply part or all of a held deposit to one invoice: records that amount as a payment on the invoice through the invoice engine. Refuses more than is held or more than the invoice still owes.

deposits.name: deposit_refund
deposits.description: Give part or all of a held deposit back to the client, with the date and how it was sent. Refuses more than is still held. The invoice server is not touched: a refund is not a payment.

deposits.name: deposit_balance
deposits.description: Answer "how much of theirs am I holding?" for one client or for everyone: received, applied to invoices, refunded and still held, one row per currency, never added across currencies.

deposits.name: deposit_statement_text
deposits.description: Turn one client's deposits into a plain-text statement with every movement in date order and the closing balance, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

deposits.name: deposit_statement_pdf
deposits.description: Call this tool to write one client's A4 deposit statement and return the file path. Titled DEPOSIT STATEMENT, every movement in date order, closing with what is still held. Pro.

deposits.name: deposits_report
deposits.description: What is held per currency, the oldest held deposits, and every deposit received more than N days ago with none of it applied to an invoice. Pro.

per-diem.name: perdiem_rates
per-diem.description: List a scheme's bundled daily allowance rates with the authority, instrument, source URL and effective date they came from. Filter by country or city. Free and unlimited.

per-diem.name: perdiem_calc
per-diem.description: Calculate the daily travel allowance for one trip: the amount per day and the total in the scheme's currency, with the partial-day fraction and the meal deductions the scheme's own rule applies. Free and unlimited.

per-diem.name: trip_record
per-diem.description: Calculate a trip and save it under a name, with the traveller taken from the shared business profile. Returns the TRIP-YYYY-NNNN id. Free tier: 5 trips a calendar month.

per-diem.name: trip_list
per-diem.description: List saved trips with the scheme, destination, dates and total on each, and a total per currency. Filter by scheme, destination, traveller, project and start date range. Free and unlimited.

per-diem.name: trip_export
per-diem.description: Return the exact expense_add arguments for a saved trip, one payload per currency, ready to pass to the expense-tracker server. It writes nothing itself: see the note in the answer. Pro.

per-diem.name: perdiem_report
per-diem.description: Total the saved trips per scheme and per calendar month, in each scheme's own currency, with the day count and the trips behind every figure. Pro.

asset-register.name: asset_add
asset-register.description: Add one fixed asset to the register and return its id with the rate, useful life and convention taken from the bundled tax table. Cost and residual are whole minor units. Free tier holds ten assets.

asset-register.name: asset_list
asset-register.description: List the assets in the register with cost, method, rate and net book value at a date, filtered by scheme, category, project, currency or disposal state. Free and unlimited.

asset-register.name: asset_schedule
asset-register.description: Build the depreciation schedule for a stored asset, or price one not yet in the register, per year or per month, to zero or residual, with the table convention applied and the periods summing exactly to the base. Free.

asset-register.name: asset_journal
asset-register.description: Return the depreciation journal for one month: debit depreciation expense and credit accumulated depreciation, per asset and in total, plus an expense_add-ready payload per currency. It writes nothing itself. Pro.

asset-register.name: asset_dispose
asset-register.description: Record the sale, scrapping or write-off of an asset on a date for a proceeds amount, and return the gain or loss against net book value at that date. Free.

asset-register.name: asset_report
asset-register.description: Report net book value by category and currency at a date, the year's depreciation charge, and every disposal in the year with its gain or loss. Pro.

statement-of-account.name: statement_build
statement-of-account.description: Build one client's statement of account for a period: opening balance, invoices issued, payments received, credit notes, deposits applied and closing balance, in minor units and formatted.

statement-of-account.name: statement_aging
statement-of-account.description: Break what is owed into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days past the invoice due date as at a chosen date, for one client or for every client, per currency. Free and unlimited.

statement-of-account.name: statement_text
statement-of-account.description: Turn one client's statement into a plain-text ledger with every movement in date order, the opening and closing balances and a sign-off, ready to paste into an email.

statement-of-account.name: statement_pdf
statement-of-account.description: Call this tool to write one client's A4 statement of account and return the file path. Titled STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT, every movement in date order, closing with the balance outstanding. Pro.

statement-of-account.name: dunning_text
statement-of-account.description: Write a payment chaser for one client at level 1 friendly, 2 firm or 3 final demand, listing every overdue invoice with its age and total, plus your bank details when the profile has them. Level 3 is Pro.

statement-of-account.name: statements_report
statement-of-account.description: Show what is outstanding across every client, totalled per currency and aged, with the oldest overdue invoice and the clients carrying it. Pro.

statement-of-account.name: license_status
statement-of-account.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

statement-of-account.name: license_activate
statement-of-account.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

cash-book.name: ledger_build
cash-book.description: Derive the double-entry ledger for one period in one currency from the invoice, credit note, deposit, expense, bank and asset stores. Every line names its source server, source id and date. Nothing is written back.

cash-book.name: trial_balance
cash-book.description: Total the debits and the credits for a period and prove they are equal to the minor unit. When they are not, name the entries whose own legs do not add up and the source document behind each. Free and unlimited.

cash-book.name: ledger_lines
cash-book.description: List the ledger lines for a period, filtered by account, by source server or source document id, and by date. Each line carries its debit and its credit in minor units and the bank row that evidences it.

cash-book.name: month_close
cash-book.description: List what a month leaves unposted or inconsistent: invoices with no VAT rate, bank debits with no expense, deposits applied to unknown invoices. Then close it with a trial balance snapshot. Pro.

cash-book.name: ledger_export_csv
cash-book.description: Return the period's ledger lines as RFC 4180 CSV, one row per leg with its date, entry, account, debit, credit, currency, source server, source id and description. No file is written. Pro.

cash-book.name: ledger_report
cash-book.description: Report every account for a period with its debits, its credits, its movement and its closing balance, plus the purchase commitments held as a memo and the exceptions the period carries. Pro.

cash-book.name: license_status
cash-book.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

cash-book.name: license_activate
cash-book.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

amortization.name: loan_create
amortization.description: Record a loan or a lease from its terms and return its id, its level payment and its effective annual rate. Principal, fees and balloon are whole minor units; the rate is nominal annual basis points.

amortization.name: loan_schedule
amortization.description: Build the schedule for one loan: opening balance, payment, interest, principal and closing balance for every period, with the total interest. The closing balance reaches the balloon, or zero, exactly. Free.

amortization.name: loan_repay_early
amortization.description: Work out what settling or overpaying costs as of a period: the outstanding balance, the penalty if one is given, the recalculated remaining schedule and the interest saved, stated gross and net of the penalty. Pro.

amortization.name: loan_journal
amortization.description: Return the double entry for one payment period or one month: debit interest expense and loan liability, credit cash, in the cash book's account names, with an expense_add-ready payload. Pro.

amortization.name: loan_list
amortization.description: List the loans and leases in the register with their terms, the level payment, the effective annual rate and the balance outstanding at a date. Free and unlimited.

amortization.name: loans_report
amortization.description: Report the debt: what is outstanding per currency, when each next payment falls due, and the interest charged in a calendar year, per loan and in total. Pro.

amortization.name: license_status
amortization.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

amortization.name: license_activate
amortization.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

petty-cash.name: float_open
petty-cash.description: Open a petty cash float on the imprest system and return its id. The imprest is the cash the tin is topped back up to at every replenishment, in whole minor units. Free tier: one float.

petty-cash.name: voucher_add
petty-cash.description: Record one voucher paid out of the tin and return its VOU-YYYY-NNNN number. More than the float holds is refused, and so is a byte-identical duplicate. Free tier: 20 vouchers a calendar month.

petty-cash.name: voucher_delete
petty-cash.description: Delete a voucher that was entered wrongly, by its VOU number. A voucher already covered by a reconciliation is refused: the cash it took out was counted, so removing it would make a past count wrong. Free.

petty-cash.name: reconcile
petty-cash.description: Count the cash and reconcile: the expected balance, the difference to the minor unit, and every voucher since the last count, which this marks reconciled. Records the count. Free and unlimited.

petty-cash.name: replenish_request
petty-cash.description: Work out what puts the float back to its imprest: the amount, the vouchers it reimburses, the totals per category as an expense_add-ready payload, and the double entry. Writes nothing. Pro.

petty-cash.name: topup_record
petty-cash.description: Record cash put into the tin: the amount in whole minor units, the date and where it came from. It reimburses every voucher up to that date, which is what a replenishment cheque does. Free.

petty-cash.name: float_report
petty-cash.description: Report every float: the balance against its imprest, what is unreconciled, the last count, and the history of what the counts found over or short, per float and in total. Pro.

petty-cash.name: license_status
petty-cash.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

petty-cash.name: license_activate
petty-cash.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

work-order.name: work_order_create
work-order.description: Raise a job order and return its WO-YYYY-NNNN number: the client, the site address, the date it was asked for, what the job is and how urgent. Free tier: 5 open orders.

work-order.name: work_order_add_line
work-order.description: Add one line to a work order: parts with a quantity and a unit cost in minor units and an optional markup percent, or labour with hours and an hourly rate. Free.

work-order.name: work_order_status
work-order.description: Move a work order one step: draft to scheduled to in_progress to done to invoiced, stamping the date and a note. A skipped or backwards step is refused by name. Free.

work-order.name: work_order_get
work-order.description: Show one work order in full: the client and the site, every parts and labour line with its billed unit, the hours, the materials, the net and VAT, and the status history. Free.

work-order.name: work_order_list
work-order.description: List work orders with their status, hours and value. Filter by status, by client, and by a requested-date range. Free.

work-order.name: work_order_delete
work-order.description: Delete a work order raised by mistake. Only a draft with no lines can go: once there is a line or a status past draft, the job has a history and is corrected, not erased. Free on every tier.

work-order.name: completion_report_text
work-order.description: Turn a work order into a plain-text completion report: what was done, the labour hours, the materials, the totals and a sign-off block, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

work-order.name: completion_report_pdf
work-order.description: Call this tool to write the A4 completion report of one work order and return the file path: the lines, the hours, the materials, the totals and the sign-off block. Pro.

work-order.name: work_order_invoice_payload
work-order.description: Build an invoice_create-ready payload from the lines, with VAT at the shared profile rate. Writes nothing and marks nothing: raise the invoice in the invoice server, then set this order invoiced. Pro.

work-order.name: work_orders_report
work-order.description: Report the whole board: how many work orders sit at each status, the hours logged this month, and the value not yet invoiced per currency, with the oldest open jobs named. Pro.

work-order.name: license_status
work-order.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

work-order.name: license_activate
work-order.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

catalogue.name: sku_set
catalogue.description: Add a catalogue line or reprice one: a code, a name, a unit, an optional VAT rate, and a price in minor units for one currency, tier and valid-from date. Free tier: 25 SKUs.

catalogue.name: sku_get
catalogue.description: Show the price of one SKU as of a date, in one currency and tier: the row picked is the latest valid_from at or before that date, and the answer names the row and any later one already booked. Free.

catalogue.name: sku_list
catalogue.description: List catalogue lines with the price in force today, filtered by code prefix, by currency and by tier. A SKU with no price in that currency and tier is listed and said to have none. Free.

catalogue.name: sku_delete
catalogue.description: Delete a catalogue line raised by mistake. Only one that no rate card points at and that has never priced a resolved line can go; the refusal names what depends on it. Free on every tier.

catalogue.name: rate_set
catalogue.description: Set the hourly rate on a labour rate card: a role, a currency, an hourly rate in minor units and the day it comes into force. An update replaces the row for that currency and date. Free.

catalogue.name: rate_get
catalogue.description: Show the hourly rate for a role as of a date and currency: the row picked is the latest valid_from at or before that date, and the answer names it. With no role given, lists every card. Free.

catalogue.name: lines_resolve
catalogue.description: Turn a list of sku or role lines into invoice_create-ready and quote_create-ready items priced from the catalogue as of each line's date. An unknown code is refused by name and never priced. Free.

catalogue.name: price_list_text
catalogue.description: Print the price list as plain text: every SKU with the price in force on a date, per currency and tier, with the valid-from date and any later price already booked, then the labour rates. Free.

catalogue.name: price_list_pdf
catalogue.description: Call this tool to write the A4 price list for one currency and tier and return the file path: every SKU with its unit, its price in force and the day that price started. Pro.

catalogue.name: catalogue_report
catalogue.description: Report the catalogue: how many SKUs there are, how many price rows are in force today, which rows a later row already replaces, and which SKUs carry no price in the profile's default currency. Pro.

catalogue.name: license_status
catalogue.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

catalogue.name: license_activate
catalogue.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

change-order.name: change_order_create
change-order.description: Raise a change order against a quote or work order and return its CO-YYYY-NNNN number: the reference, the client, a title, the date, and the original contract value in minor units. Free tier: 5 open.

change-order.name: change_order_add_line
change-order.description: Add one line to a draft change order: added or removed with a quantity and a unit price in minor units, or changed with the old and the new quantity and price, each with a reason and a date. Free.

change-order.name: change_order_status
change-order.description: Move a change order: draft to sent, sent to approved or rejected, draft or sent to void, stamping the date and a note. Approved, rejected and void are final, and a draft cannot be approved unsent. Free.

change-order.name: change_order_get
change-order.description: Show one change order in full: every added, removed and changed line with its reason and delta, the VAT, the delta gross, the status history and the running value of the reference. Free.

change-order.name: change_order_list
change-order.description: List change orders with their status and delta. Filter by reference, by status, by client, and by a date range. Free.

change-order.name: change_order_delete
change-order.description: Delete a change order raised by mistake. Only a draft with no lines can go: once there is a line or it has been sent, it has a history and is voided, not erased. Free on every tier.

change-order.name: contract_value
change-order.description: The running value of one quote or work order: the original, the approved deltas and the current value, with pending draft and sent deltas shown separately and never added in. Free on every tier.

change-order.name: change_order_document
change-order.description: Render one change order as a plain-text document for the client to approve: every line with its reason, the delta net and gross, the contract value before and after, and an approval block. Pro.

change-order.name: change_order_invoice_payload
change-order.description: Build the approved delta as invoice_create-ready items in MAJOR units and quote_create-ready items in MINOR units, with VAT at the shared profile rate. Writes nothing and creates nothing. Pro.

change-order.name: license_status
change-order.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

change-order.name: license_activate
change-order.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

delivery-schedule.name: delivery_schedule_create
delivery-schedule.description: Open a delivery schedule against a quote, work order or change order and return its DS-YYYY-NNNN number: the reference, its own date, the client, a title and the currency. Free tier: 3 open.

delivery-schedule.name: deliverable_add
delivery-schedule.description: Add one deliverable to a schedule: what it is, the day it is due, and its value in whole minor units when it is separately priced. It starts as planned. Free on every tier.

delivery-schedule.name: deliverable_status
delivery-schedule.description: Record a dated move on one deliverable: planned to in progress, to delivered, and delivered to accepted with the acceptance note. Accepting something never delivered is refused. Free.

delivery-schedule.name: deliverable_delete
delivery-schedule.description: Delete a deliverable added by mistake. Only one still planned with nothing recorded against it can go: once it has been started or handed over it has a history. Free on every tier.

delivery-schedule.name: delivery_schedule_get
delivery-schedule.description: Show one schedule in full as at a date: every deliverable with its due date, status, delivered and accepted dates, acceptance note and value, plus what is late as at that date. Free.

delivery-schedule.name: delivery_schedule_list
delivery-schedule.description: List delivery schedules with their counts as at a date: what is late, what is still owed and what has been accepted. Filter by client, by reference and by whether the job is complete. Free.

delivery-schedule.name: delivery_schedule_delete
delivery-schedule.description: Delete a delivery schedule opened by mistake. Only one with no deliverables can go: once it carries one, it carries a record of what was owed. Free on every tier.

delivery-schedule.name: late_report
delivery-schedule.description: What has slipped as at a date you name: every deliverable still owed whose due date has passed, worst first, with the value at risk per currency and what was delivered late for the record. Free.

delivery-schedule.name: delivery_schedule_document
delivery-schedule.description: Render one schedule as a plain-text document for the client: every deliverable with its due date, status, delivered and accepted dates and value, the counts as at a date, and a sign-off block. Pro.

delivery-schedule.name: milestone_payload
delivery-schedule.description: Build the delivered-and-accepted deliverables as invoice_create-ready items in MAJOR units and quote_create-ready items in MINOR units, with VAT at the shared profile rate. Writes nothing. Pro.

delivery-schedule.name: license_status
delivery-schedule.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

delivery-schedule.name: license_activate
delivery-schedule.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

packing-list.name: packing_list_create
packing-list.description: Open a packing list against an order and return its PL-YYYY-NNNN number: the order reference, the consignee, where it ships to and the date. Free tier: 3 open at once; shipping or cancelling frees a slot.

packing-list.name: packing_expect
packing-list.description: Add an ordered line to a packing list so the shortfall is real: a SKU, a description and a quantity. Nothing is read from the quotes, work order or invoice store; what the order says is stated here.

packing-list.name: carton_add
packing-list.description: Add a carton to a packing list and return its C01-style id: a label, the empty weight in WHOLE GRAMS, and optionally length, width and height in WHOLE CENTIMETRES. Dimensions are what make a chargeable weight possible.

packing-list.name: pack_item
packing-list.description: Put a quantity of one item into a named carton: a description, how many, and the per-unit weight in WHOLE GRAMS. Leave unit_grams out when it was not weighed and the carton gross comes back as a lower bound.

packing-list.name: unpack_item
packing-list.description: Remove one packed line from a packing list by its L01-style id and return the carton it came out of. The line is deleted, not zeroed, so the slip does not print an item nobody packed.

packing-list.name: packing_list_show
packing-list.description: The whole packing list: its cartons with contents and derived weights, the ordered lines, the shortfall, whether it is ready to ship and why not, and its status history. Nothing here is stored; it is computed.

packing-list.name: packing_list_list
packing-list.description: Packing lists newest first, with cartons, units, gross weight and how many ordered lines are still short. Filter by status, by order reference or by consignee. Returns at most 500 rows.

packing-list.name: carton_report
packing-list.description: Per carton and for the shipment: tare, net, gross, volume, volumetric weight and the chargeable weight, the greater of gross and volumetric. A carton with no dimensions makes the chargeable total null, never a guess.

packing-list.name: packing_shortfall
packing-list.description: Ordered against packed, line by line: what is still short, what was over-packed, and what was packed that is not on the order at all. A packed line with no ordered line is reported, never dropped.

packing-list.name: packing_list_status
packing-list.description: Move a packing list draft to packed to shipped, or cancel it. Shipping records the carrier, the tracking number and the date, and freezes the list. A shipped list cannot be reopened or edited.

packing-list.name: packing_slip
packing-list.description: The packing slip as plain text on every tier: cartons, contents, weights and a signature line, and no prices anywhere. Pro also writes it to out_path as a .txt file. Refuses a URL and refuses to overwrite unless told to.

packing-list.name: packing_list_delete
packing-list.description: Delete a packing list for good, with its cartons and packed lines. A shipped list is refused: it is the record of what left the building. Cancel a list you no longer want instead of deleting a real shipment.

packing-list.name: license_status
packing-list.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

packing-list.name: license_activate
packing-list.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.

checklist.name: checklist_create
checklist.description: Create a reusable checklist and return its CL-NNNN id: a name, a category and an optional description. Add the steps with checklist_item_add. Free tier: 3 checklists, and unlimited runs of them.

checklist.name: checklist_item_add
checklist.description: Add one step to a checklist and return its I01-style id: the text, an optional section heading, and whether it is required. A required step that is unanswered or failed blocks sign-off; an optional one does not.

checklist.name: checklist_item_remove
checklist.description: Remove one step from a checklist by its I01-style id and bump the checklist version. Runs already under way keep the step they started with, so nothing anybody already ticked is rewritten.

checklist.name: checklist_show
checklist.description: One checklist with its steps in order, grouped by section, plus how many are required and how many runs have been started from it. Pass as_text for a blank printable copy with a box against each step.

checklist.name: checklist_list
checklist.description: Every checklist with its category, version, step count and how many runs came from it. Filter by category or by a word in the name. Returns at most 500 rows, newest change first.

checklist.name: checklist_delete
checklist.description: Delete a checklist and its steps for good. Runs already started from it are untouched and stay readable: a run carries its own copy of the steps, so deleting the checklist does not erase what anybody signed.

checklist.name: run_start
checklist.description: Start a dated run of a checklist and return its RUN-YYYY-NNNN id. The steps are COPIED into the run, so editing the checklist afterwards never changes a run already under way. Runs are free and never capped.

checklist.name: run_check
checklist.description: Mark one step pass, fail or na, with who did it and when. na means the step did not apply; it counts as answered and never as passed. A step can be answered again while the run is open, and the last answer stands.

checklist.name: run_show
checklist.description: The whole run: every step with its answer, who answered it and when, grouped by section, plus the pass, fail and outstanding counts, the failures in full, and whether it can be signed off and why not.

checklist.name: run_list
checklist.description: Runs newest first, with their checklist, progress and sign-off state. Filter by checklist, by status, by reference or to open runs only. Returns at most 500 rows.

checklist.name: run_sign_off
checklist.description: Sign off a completed run with a name and a date, which freezes it. Refused while a required step is unanswered or failed, unless force is true, and either way the exceptions stay on the record and print on the report.

checklist.name: run_status
checklist.description: Move a run back to open so a step can be answered again, or abandon it when the job did not happen. A signed-off run is refused: a signature is the point at which a run stops moving.

checklist.name: run_report
checklist.description: The run as plain text on every tier: every step with its mark, who answered it, the notes, the counts and a signature block or the recorded signature. Pro also writes it to out_path as a .txt file.

checklist.name: run_delete
checklist.description: Delete a run for good, with every answer on it. A signed-off run is refused: it is the record of what somebody put their name to. Abandon a run you no longer want instead of deleting a signed one.

checklist.name: license_status
checklist.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

checklist.name: license_activate
checklist.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.
